blocks.text:
As described in the [appendix](#signal-handler-sequence)
      event signals are propagated in 3 phases:
blocks.zh: 如[附录](#signal-handler-sequence)所述，事件信号分三个阶段传播：

blocks.text: Capture phase - runs from the toplevel down to the event widget.
blocks.zh: 捕获阶段——从顶级窗口向下运行，直到事件所在的部件。

blocks.text: Target phase - runs only on the event widget.
blocks.zh: 目标阶段——只在事件所在的部件上运行。

blocks.text: Bubble phase - runs from the event widget up to the toplevel.
blocks.zh: 冒泡阶段——从事件所在的部件向上运行，直到顶级窗口。

blocks.text:
A keyboard event is first sent to the toplevel window
      (`Gtk::Window`), where it will be checked
      for any keyboard shortcuts that may be set (accelerator keys and mnemonics,
      used for selecting menu items from the keyboard). After this (and assuming
      the event wasn't handled), it is propagated down until it reaches the widget
      which has keyboard focus. The event will then propagate up until it reaches
      the top-level widget, or until you stop the propagation by returning
      `true` from an event handler.
blocks.zh: 键盘事件首先被发送到顶级窗口（`Gtk::Window`），在那里检查是否设置了键盘快捷键（用于从键盘选择菜单项的加速键和助记符）。在此之后（假设事件没有被处理），事件向下传播，直到到达拥有键盘焦点的部件。然后事件向上传播，直到到达顶级部件，或者你在某个事件处理函数里返回 `true` 来停止传播。

blocks.text:
Notice, that after canceling an event, no other function will be called
      (even if it is from the same widget).
blocks.zh: 请注意，取消事件之后，不再会调用其他函数（哪怕它来自同一个部件）。

blocks.text:
In this example there are 9 `EventControllerKey`s,
        3 in each of a `Gtk::Window`, a `Gtk::Box`
        and a `Gtk::Label`. In each of the widgets there is
        one event controller for each propagation phase.
blocks.zh: 在此示例中有 9 个 `EventControllerKey`：`Gtk::Window`、`Gtk::Box` 和 `Gtk::Label` 各有 3 个。在每个部件里，每个传播阶段各有一个事件控制器。

blocks.text: The purpose of this example is to show the steps the event takes when it is emitted.
blocks.zh: 本示例的目的是显示事件发出时进行的步骤。

blocks.text:
When you write in the label, a key press event will be emitted,
        which will go first, in the capture phase, to the toplevel window
        (`Gtk::Window`), then down to its child, the
        box, then to the box's child, the label with the keyboard focus.
        In the target phase the event goes only to the widget with the keyboard
        focus (the label). In the bubble phase the event goes first to the widget
        with the keyboard focus (the label), then to its parent (the box), then
        to the box's parent (the window). If the event propagates all the way
        down to the label and then up to the window without being stopped,
        the text you're writing will appear in the `Label`
        above the `Label` you're writing in.
blocks.zh: 当你在标签里写入时，会发出一个按键按下事件：它先在捕获阶段进入顶级窗口（`Gtk::Window`），然后向下到它的子部件 Box，再到 Box 的子部件，也就是拥有键盘焦点的 Label。在目标阶段，事件只发给拥有键盘焦点的部件（Label）。在冒泡阶段，事件先发给拥有键盘焦点的部件（Label），再发给它的父部件（Box），再发给 Box 的父部件（窗口）。如果事件一路向下传到 Label、再向上传到窗口而没有被停止，你写入的文字就会出现在你正在写入的 `Label` 上方的 `Label` 里。
